turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail: shows: - Information Received: Please allow 24 hours for the courier’s first scan to appear. - In transit: It’s normal for tracking to remain in this status for up to 7 business days. - Out for delivery: Delivery should usually occur within 24–48 hours. - Pending: Your order is still being processed, and tracking may take up to 24–48 hours to become available. If the tracking has exceeded the relevant timeframe above, would you like to share the status currently shown so I can help interpret it?
